tools.name: recover_continuity
tools.description: Recover a deterministic, read-only, globally bounded checkpoint from existing review, verification, project-context, and project-memory evidence. Sources are consumed in that priority order; this tool does not persist state, select work, execute verification, or inject host context.

discovery.note: Complete, stable tools/list is always served. This card carries a compact index (names, descriptions, risk hints) for hosts that progressively disclose model-visible definitions; tool definitions are never made connection-local or model-use-dependent.
